title: Where should the trail map be drawn?
context: Alex's trail planner shows a route on a topographic map. Panning and zooming must stay smooth on a phone, out on the trail.

options.name: Vector tiles in the browser
options.summary: Download map data as vector tiles and draw them on the device.
pros: Small downloads, easy to keep offline later

options.name: Ready-made image tiles
options.summary: Fetch pre-drawn map pictures from a tile server.

recommendation: Offline use is likely to come up, and vector tiles keep it small.
reason: Smooth zoom matters most when reading contours on a small screen.
